title: Cyberpunk Stock Market Roguelite
author: DojiRun
selftext:
I have been working on this game for a little over a year now, mostly just moonlighting. Its an idea i have had in my head for a while, it went through many design iterations to land at this theme with this gameplay. I have always liked media that is surprising and absurd, so that is what I have made here. I have used Claude to help with coding on the more complicated market functions and for debugging, it has been a godsend for that. I used elevenlabs for some VO work, starting out with my own voice and tweaking it from there. It just made the game feel better so I did that. I would love to hear some opinions on this, its been hard to get much love in the other gaming subs on this site, they are in such a toxic state or would rather just complain about ai rather than read normal posts that are asking for feedback. 

  
Let me know if you like, or dont like what you see, I am very open to suggestions, making a game has always been something i wanted to do, but getting feedback, even harsh truths is the only way to grow and see your blind spots! Ask me anything!
